shapeSummary: Rectangular black motor-controller block 32.5 (X) x 23.5 (Y, height) x 60 (Z, length) mm. Bottom at Y=0, centered in X and Z. Ten shallow cooling grooves cut across the top face. Shallow USB and 2x5 header pockets on the +Z end face. Wires, LEDs and labels are not modeled.
warnings: Dimensions come from unverified catalog values (60 x 32.5 x 23.5 mm).
Y is treated as vertical per the rules, so the 60 mm length lies along Z. This differs from the image-analysis bounds, which list Y as 60.
Fin count, depth, pitch and orientation are estimated from the photo. The diagonal look of the ridges is perspective, so straight transverse grooves were used.
The wire bundle on the -Z end is omitted because its length and routing are unknown.
The three LEDs and all text are omitted.
The USB and header pockets are approximate in size and position, and the stepped end-face profile is simplified.
cadquery:
W=32.5
H=23.5
L=60
body=cq.Workplane('XY').box(W,H,L,centered=(True,False,True))
# cooling grooves across the top (run through the full width)
gd=4.0
gw=1.6
pitch=3.6
n=10
z0=-24
for i in range(n):
    z=z0+i*pitch
    cutter=cq.Workplane('XY').box(W+2,gd+1,gw,centered=(True,False,True)).translate((0,H-gd,z))
    body=body.cut(cutter)
# front-face USB port recess and 2x5 CTRL header recess (+Z end)
usb=cq.Workplane('XY').box(7.5,2.6,6,centered=(True,True,True)).translate((-9,6,L/2-1.5))
hdr=cq.Workplane('XY').box(10,4.5,6,centered=(True,True,True)).translate((5,6.5,L/2-1.5))
part=body.cut(usb).cut(hdr)
